i.norm: Verifies that cleanName applies all four normalization steps in sequence: 1. Upper-case ("This-ís a t.,es &t" -> "THIS-ÍS A T.,ES &T") 2. Strip punctuation (hyphens, ampersands, apostrophes, periods, commas) -> "THISÍS A TES T" 3. Remove accents (Í -> I) -> "THISIS A TES T" 4. Collapse/remove spaces -> "THISISATEST"
Input deliberately contains mixed case, accented characters, extra spaces, and punctuation that cleanName must eliminate.
After upper-casing, stripping punctuation, removing accents, and collapsing all whitespace the result is a plain ASCII string.
